items.title: Transparent Tribe Hacker Group Attacking India’s Startup Ecosystem
items.description: The threat landscape for India’s technology sector has taken an unexpected turn. A Pakistan-based hacking group called Transparent Tribe has shifted its focus from traditional government targets to the country’s vibrant startup ecosystem, particularly companies working in cybersecurity and intelligence domains. items.title: Bulletproof Hosting Providers Leverage Legitimate ISPsystem to Supply Servers for Cybercriminals
items.description: In the constantly shifting landscape of online threats, cybercriminals have found a new way to strengthen their attacks by hiding behind legitimate technology. items.title: New FvncBot Attacking Android Users by Exploiting Accessibility Services
items.description: A dangerous new malicious application has surfaced, targeting mobile banking customers in Poland. Observed on November 25, 2025, this threat masquerades as a legitimate security tool purportedly from mBank, a major Polish financial institution. items.title: "Encrypt It Already" Campaign Pushes Big Tech to Prioritize E2E Encryption
items.description: The Electronic Frontier Foundation is urging major technology companies to follow through on their promises to implement end-to-end encryption by default across their services, as privacy concerns mount amid increased AI use.
